1544  000542  %***********************************************
1545  000542  %IOX 303 WRITE CONSOLE INPUT CONTROL
1546  000542  %CC MACRO STATUS WORD UPON ENTRY:
1547  000542  %CC PIN=BIT0,WORD LENGTH =BIT12,11,STOP BITS=BIT13,CHECK PARITY=BIT14
1548  000542  %CC WORD LENGTH 5 => 1 1 0=>1.5 STOP BITS
1549  000542  %CC WORD LENGTH 6 => 1 0 0=>2 STOP BITS
1550  000542  %CC WORD LENGTH 7 => 0 1 0=>2 STOP BITS
1551  000542  %CC WORD LENGTH 8 => 0 0 0=>2 STOP BITS
1552  000542  %CC PARITY IS EVEN
1553  000542  %CC OTHER BITS 0.
1554  000542  %CC UART MODE REG 1: CHECK PARITY=BIT4,WORD LENGTH=BIT2,3 INVERTED
1555  000542  %CC STOP BITS=BIT7,6. 01=1 STOP BIT,10=1.5 STOP BITS, 11=2 STOP BITS.
1556  000542  %CC BIT0=0,BIT1=1,BIT5=1 ALWAYS. (EVEN PARITY,ASYNC. 16XBAUD RATE FACT.)
1557  000542

1559  000542   COND,F=0                                       F,NEXT      F,HOLD
1560  000542                                                  T,NEXT      T,HOLD;

0197  004054  % INSTRUCTIONS TO SPEED UP SINTRAN III SEGMENT HANDLING %

0199  004054  %
0200  004054  %*****************************************************************
0201  004054  %*****************************************************************
0202  004054  %
0203  004054  % OPCODE 140300 : SETPT                                 %
0204  004054  %
0205  004054  % SETPT: JXZ * 10 % FINISHED                            %
0206  004054  % LDDTIX 20                                             %
0207  004054  % BSET ZRO 130 DA % PGU-BIT                             %
0208  004054  % LDBTX 10                                              %
0209  004054  % 177777 % OLD BUG IN LDBTX                             %
0210  004054  % STD ,B % ALWAYS INSIDE PAGE TABLE                     %
0211  004054  % LDDTIX 00                                             %
0212  004054  % JMP * -7                                              %
0213  004054  %
0214  004054  %********************************************************%
0215  004054  %
0216  004054  % OPCODE 140301 : CLEPT                                 %
0217  004054  %
0218  004054  % CLEPT: JXZ * 11 % FINISHED                            %
0219  004054  % LDBTX 10                                              %
0220  004054  % 177777 % OLD BUG IN LDBTX                             %
0221  004054  % LDA ,B                                                %
0222  004054  % JAZ * 3                                               %
0223  004054  % STATX 20 % ALWAYS INSIDE PAGE TABLE                   %
0224  004054  % STZ ,B                                                %
0225  004054  % LDDTIX 00                                             %
0226  004054  % JMP * -10                                             %
0227  004054  %
0228  004054  %********************************************************%
0229  004054  %
0230  004054  % OPCODE 140302 : CLNREENT                              %
0231  004054  %
0232  004054  % READ ADDRESS A+2 TO FIND PAGE TABLE TO BE AFFECTED    %
0233  004054  % READ RT-DESCRIPTION BITMAP WORDS. FOUND FROM ADDRESS X+25. %
0234  004054  % CLEAR PAGE-TABLE ENTRIES CORRESPONDING TO 1-BITS IN BITMAP. %
0235  004054  % THE LAST BITMAP-ADDRESS IS IN ADDRESS X+T.            %
0236  004054  %
0237  004054  %********************************************************%
0238  004054  %
0239  004054  % OPCODE 140303 ; CHREENTPAGES
0240  004054  %
0241  004054  %  1. READ ADDRESS D,X -> R1 ; D,X -> PREVIOUS (SCRATCH REG)
0242  004054  %  2. IF R1 = 0: SKIP RETURN (FINISHED)
0243  004054  %  3. READ ADDRESS T,R1+2
0244  004054  %  4. IF NOT WIF; T,R1 -> PREVIOUS; READ ADDR T,R1 -> R1; GOTO 2
0245  004054  %  5. READ ADDRESS T,R1 -> R2
0246  004054  %  6. WRITE R2 -> ADDRESS PREVIOUS
0247  004054  %  7. R1 -> X ; PREVIOUS -> D,A ; RETURN
0248  004054  %
0249  004054  %***********************************************************************
0250  004054  %
0251  004054  % OPCODE 140304 ; CLEUP
0252  004054  %
0253  004054  % AS 'CLEPT', BUT INCLUDING WORKING SET INFORMATION

0255  004054  % IF PGU OF ENTRY IS 1

0257  004054  %   B /1 776 SHR 1 - D

0259  004054  %   B-REG BITS 4-6 IS NOW WORD NUMBER

0261  004054  %   POINTED TO BY L-REGISTER

0263  004054  % LAYOUT OF 8-WORD TABLE :
0264  004054  %
0265  004054  %   BIT 15                                             BIT 0

0269  004054  %   WORD 2 # PAGE 57                                   40 #
